title: xFusion scales enterprise AI from edge workstations to liquid-cooled data centres
summary: xFusion showcased scalable enterprise AI computing solutions at ISC 2026, presenting a four-tier hardware framework that spans from edge workstations to liquid-cooled data centers. The solution addresses common enterprise challenges including physical operating constraints in hardware selection and data security risks from public API dependencies.
problem_solved: Helps enterprises overcome hardware scaling challenges when deploying AI workloads across edge devices and data centers while maintaining data security.
why_valuable: Provides a practical production-ready framework for enterprises to systematically scale AI infrastructure from edge to core, addressing both performance and security concerns.
